document: Cross-model Formal Runner Closure / Post-repair Readiness

resolution.frozen_pilot_runner_4838f1cb08d879a353aa: verified as run_matrix.py at commit e8ec3e0
resolution.working_pilot_runner_c3b8f0423ff8a560006: uncommitted pilot-only patch adding endpoint snapshot fallback; retained as pilot evidence, not adopted as formal runner

checks.evidence: formal runner verifies size and SHA-256 for every input file; --check passed.
rendered prompt manifest matches; sample prompts are non-identical.
all four models have model_id, repo_id, architecture, snapshot_revision, config_sha256, and inference_config.
runner queries /models, records active IDs, prefers repo_id, allows frozen snapshot_revision fallback, and aborts on mismatch.
FORMAL, PILOT_ONLY_NOT_FORMAL, INVALID_ISOLATION, RUNTIME_ERROR, INCOMPLETE are implemented.
formal_runner.py is separate from run_matrix.py; formal outputs use formal-artifacts/formal-runs path and do not read pilot runs.
each cell receives a new execution_id and X-Session-ID; no session is reused.
RUN_RECORD stores model_id, repo_id, endpoint identifier, active endpoint IDs, and identity match.
sample hashes are checked and prompt/request hashes are recorded.
per-cell isolation manifest must assert cache_prefix_excluded=true with evidence; runner aborts otherwise.
per-cell isolation manifest must assert fresh_process=true and reload_completed=true with evidence.
RUN_RECORD stores endpoint probe times, request started_at, finished_at, and elapsed_seconds.
per-cell isolation manifest must assert concurrent_workload_excluded=true with evidence; runner aborts otherwise.
formal input lineage contains only frozen cross-model sample files and records round1_residue_excluded=true.
each cell has isolated directory/execution UUID; per-cell manifest must assert other_cell_state_excluded=true.
prompt, request, raw response, final answer, metadata, hashes, and isolation evidence are retained; no normalization is performed.
only --check, --plan, and --render were invoked; no endpoint completion request was sent.

decision.next_trigger: separate explicit authorization to execute 16 formal cells
